content: 'Iya tukaritsie, Yawé 'iteɨrieya meukuyɨra witsipɨ'aneni meta witsipɨtiyuxexeiyani, kwiepa timieme 'ikwaxi puwatemawieritɨani keyupaɨmetɨ 'ixaheritsixi memɨtawikweni.
Hikɨ kemɨ'ane Tsiyunitsie 'ayenieretɨ muyuhayewa meta kemɨ'ane Kerutsaremetsie 'ayenieretɨ muyuhayewa mɨkɨ Memɨpatsietɨka mepɨtetetewaka, meta mepaye'uxani Kerutsaremetsie tukari memexeiyanikɨ.

Ti'aitame Yawé 'iyari tiyu'uximatɨwamekɨ meta 'iyari taikɨ mɨtiyuxɨtsitɨwakɨ, Yawé Tsiyuni niwemama 'ɨimarixi kaniwahauximɨkɨ titakɨ memɨkate'itiyatɨkateikɨ meta xuriya pakuyeitɨani Kerutsareme kepaɨmetɨ makuxuaweni.

Hikɨ Yawé hai kɨtsiyari pɨtawewieni tukarikɨ mieme meta tai kwinimieme 'anutatetereme tɨkarikɨ mieme, Tsiyuni hɨriyaritsie meta kemɨ'ane mana memuyutixexeɨriwa yunaime waheima. Naime xawatɨriya heima panukawereni 'ɨkari 'atsuitɨ
mɨkɨ mɨwaranukanakakɨ, tukarikɨ mɨ'etɨriwiekakɨ, muwa'awietanikɨ wiyerikɨ meta wiyeri mɨ'ekama hepaɨtsita.
